claim: Which scripts get update calls: the front end's main.advert (OnUpdate) only on the main menu; no other front-end screen pumps, and an OnUpdate injected into the front-end root is never called; the battle root gets OnUpdatePulse (not OnUpdate); the campaign pumps too: ctl lua requests are answered in context campaign (J9 run 20261101_j9pc, campaign_start, also after a character selection)
